Catalyst·Wayfare AI | Agent Builder | Remote (US ET Overlap) | Full-time / Part-time / Contract | https://catalystwayfare.ai/careers

AI transformation firm shipping production AI systems for mid-market enterprises in regulated and technical domains — finance, energy, industrials, healthcare. We do not stop at PowerPoint AI strategy. We ship working systems alongside our clients' engineering teams. Small teams, deep expertise, real autonomy on real work.

Hiring: AI Engineer, Agent Builder — Hands-on builder delivering key projects within multi-agent orchestrations — initially for one of the country's leading power engineering firms. End-to-end ownership of individual capability agents — prompts, tools, retrieval, deterministic checks, evals, monitoring, enabling infrastructure setup. 3–5+ yrs strong Python, real production LLM API experience, shipped multiple agentic systems end-to-end. 1099 contract, ~20–40 hrs/wk. Occasional US travel, where feasible. International candidates will be considered subject to US ET time-zone overlap. https://catalystwayfare.ai/jd-builder

Apply: per the JD's instructions, to talent+hn@cwai.co. Short cover note and impressive repos matter more than a resume.
